findings.title: Preserve range-variable checks before interpolation
findings.body: This interpolates each expression before `querySupportsSplitting` checks it. If `applyTemplateVariables` expands `$__range`, the later `isQueryWithRangeVariable` guard can no longer recognize the query and it will be split. That guard exists because `$__range` must be evaluated against the split time range; instead, each chunk can use the full dashboard-range value, producing incorrect or overlapping results. Check split eligibility against the original expression or preserve range-variable queries as non-splitting.

findings.title: Drop targets that become empty after interpolation
findings.body: The empty-expression filter runs before interpolation. A nonempty expression such as `$query` can pass that filter and then resolve to an empty string, but it is still partitioned and sent to `runQuery` as an empty Loki expression. This bypasses the existing empty-query skip and can produce unnecessary backend requests and parse errors. Filter the interpolated targets for empty expressions as well.
